method: Inverse-reported-variance circular mean of baseline azimuth minus time-aligned INS-good azimuth on the separate calibration recording.
interpretation: Empirical effective installation offset. No surveyed mounting angle is available.
headingErrorScaleMethod: Opposite-half wrapped RMS on the separate calibration drive, applying each half's offset to the other. Includes reference, mounting and synchronization error.
positionErrorScaleMethod: Median of the RMS of receiver-reported north and east standard deviations on the calibration drive.
